issues.issue: Whether there was a reasonable possibility of success for the damages action under s. 225.4 of the Securities Act.
issues.applicant_position: 121851 alleges breach of disclosure obligations due to FDA briefing materials indicating diabetes risk as a material change.
issues.respondent_position: Theratechnologies argues no material change occurred; FDA questions were routine and prior disclosures sufficed.
issues.result_text: No evidence of material change; action cannot reasonably succeed under s. 225.4.

issues.issue: Whether the FDA's briefing materials and questions about side effects constituted a material change triggering disclosure obligations under s. 73.
issues.applicant_position: FDA concerns about diabetes risk represent a material change affecting business requiring disclosure.
issues.respondent_position: FDA questions were routine, part of approval process, and did not disclose new material information.
issues.result_text: FDA questions are routine and not a material change requiring disclosure.
